purpose.text: A read-only study mirror of the client's CRM, then the branch where SISO rewrites it natively (Postgres, S3-compatible storage, staff and creator roles). The repo description reads: "Read-only study mirror of the client's upstream repo (private; push disabled by name). Analysis only — never push upstream." The rewrite lives on one working branch; main is still the 17 Aug import.
